about.title: About us
about.subtitle: A small bookshop with a large ambition

sections.title: We started on Al-Mutanabbi Street
sections.body: Noqta began as a small shelf on Al-Mutanabbi Street in Baghdad and grew into a store that delivers nationwide. The selection is still made by hand: we read before we stock.

sections.title: Why we choose carefully
sections.body: We do not list everything in print. We pick good editions and trusted translations, and we write about each book so you can decide before you buy.

sections.title: How we work
sections.body: We buy from publishers directly, wrap every order by hand, and support cash on delivery — trust is built by experience, not promises.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.subtitle: We usually reply within one working day
contact.name: Name
contact.subject: Subject

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: What people ask most before ordering

items.title: How long does delivery take?
items.body: 2 to 5 working days depending on the governorate, or within 24 hours for express delivery inside Baghdad.

items.title: Is cash on delivery available?
items.body: Yes, and it is the default option. You can inspect the order before paying the courier.

items.title: What if a book arrives damaged?
items.body: Tell us within 7 days and we will replace it or refund you in full, with shipping on us.

items.title: Are the books authentic?
items.body: Yes. We buy from publishers and their authorised distributors directly.

items.title: Can I request a book you do not stock?
items.body: Send us the title through the contact page and we will try to source it and quote you a price.

shipping.title: Shipping & delivery
shipping.subtitle: Everything to know before you order

sections.title: Areas and timing
sections.body: We deliver to every Iraqi governorate. Baghdad: 1–2 working days. Elsewhere: 2–5 working days.

sections.title: Shipping cost
sections.body: 5,000 IQD on orders under 50,000 IQD and free above that. Express delivery inside Baghdad is 10,000 IQD.

sections.title: Store pickup
sections.body: You can collect from our Al-Mutanabbi Street branch at no cost; we hold the order for 5 days.

returns.title: Returns & exchanges
returns.subtitle: A clear policy with no hidden conditions

sections.title: Return window
sections.body: 7 days from delivery for damaged or incorrect books, provided the cover and condition are unchanged.

sections.title: How to return a book
sections.body: Call us or use the contact page with your order number and a photo, and we will arrange collection.

sections.title: Refunds
sections.body: Refunded in cash when the book is collected, or as store credit if you prefer.

sections.title: Data we collect
sections.body: Name, phone number and address purely to fulfil the order, plus your email if you subscribe to the monthly letter.

sections.title: How we use it
sections.body: To prepare orders and talk to you about them. We never sell your data or share it with third parties for marketing.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You can ask us to correct your details or delete your account at any time through the contact page.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.subtitle: The rules we both work by

sections.title: Orders and prices
sections.body: Prices are in Iraqi dinars and include tax where applicable. We may cancel an order if stock runs out, and will tell you.

sections.title: Your account
sections.body: You are responsible for keeping your account details private and for every order placed through it.

sections.title: Intellectual property
sections.body: The site's text and design belong to Noqta and may not be republished without written permission.

publishers.title: Publishers
publishers.subtitle: The partners who stock our shelves

sections.title: Direct relationships
sections.body: We work with more than a hundred Arabic publishers and authorised distributors to guarantee original editions and fair prices.

sections.title: Are you a publisher?
sections.body: To list your titles on Noqta, write to us through the contact page with your catalogue and distribution terms.

sections.title: Rare editions
sections.body: We search for out-of-print editions on request and tell you the price and availability before any commitment.

careers.title: Careers
careers.subtitle: We look for people who love books and detail

sections.title: Why Noqta
sections.body: A small team, fast decisions, and work whose effect you see directly at the reader's door. Based in Baghdad, partly remote.

sections.title: Open roles
sections.body: Warehouse lead, customer support agent, and books content editor. Full time, based in Baghdad.

sections.title: How to apply
sections.body: Send your CV and a short note about the last book you loved through the contact page.
